notes: BOTH round-1 blockers discharged, at the customer boundary. Word order A ('cabana dealer promo for CBS212-WH', round-1 exec 12041502 leaked Sorento files with NO notice): the LLM again emitted NO brand entity and access_levels ['Cabana Dealer']; D9 recovers query_brands ['cabana'] from the compound and the routing team is marketing_promotion_cabana (round 1 downgraded it to marketing_promotion_sorento). Word order B ('cabana promo for CBS212-WH dealer', round-1 exec 12041565 rendered the notice AND attached 6 Sorento pdfs): now 0 answers, 0 attachments, ZERO send-message-files egress entries, _brand_gate_closed true. Both replies are exactly the notice + escalation offer naming the cabana team. get-results was pinned to a NON-EMPTY 6-row payload on purpose, so the suppression is proven to be n8n's own, not the CRM's — BLOCKER-2's unverified assumption is now irrelevant to the boundary.
